concurrent_load: Same-host B static gates and root native/strict-Clippy development checks run concurrently. The original fixed-host pressure contract is not exercised.
qualification_scope: Finite models and declared contract controls only. No all-legal-strategy lower bound, empirical upper bound, hidden-state premise, physical/quantum resource bound, original business deadline or mixed-consensus qualification.

suite_results.child_exit_scope: This result is the unittest parent process. Existing child CLI negative/HOLD exits are asserted inside unchanged tests; no child exit is substituted for the parent result. Per-child output is not independently instrumented beyond the suite's raw logs.
suite_results.declared_child_semantics: One child CLI returning 3 is an EXPECTED tested HOLD_NO_GO contract; the unittest parent still expects exit 0. Do not flatten child exit 3 into a suite failure.
